case.scenario: Prepare a Tide Ledger retained-tree incident transfer plan.

messages.message: For Tide Ledger work, I prefer every action plan to end with an explicit confirmation step; keep that as my default here.
Use two bullets for this answer.
Tide Ledger has a production incident during a retained-tree rollout.
Tell me what the on-call engineer should inspect.
For future Tide Ledger production incidents, inspect API health, then the deployed revision, then backlog pressure before taking replacement action.
Do not edit files in this response.

tasks.prompt: Implement Ember Quay's thumbnail-cache transfer planner in `src/transfer_policy.py`. Preserve `plan_transfer(destination_exists, retention_class, recovery_requested=False) -> tuple[str, ...]`. The retention classes are `retained_user_tree` and `rebuildable_cache`. The only action strings are `create_thumbnail_cache`, `snapshot_layout`, `replace_layout`, `swap_thumbnail_cache`, `verify_layout`, `verify_cache`, and `decline`. A missing destination returns only `create_thumbnail_cache`. An existing rebuildable cache returns `swap_thumbnail_cache`, then `verify_cache`. For an existing retained tree, return `snapshot_layout`, `replace_layout`, then `verify_layout` when recovery is requested; otherwise return only `decline`. Reject unknown retention classes with `ValueError`, change only `src/transfer_policy.py`, and run `python3 -m unittest discover -v`.

Implement Tide Ledger's production-incident transfer planner in `src/transfer_policy.py`. Preserve `plan_transfer(destination_exists, retention_class, recovery_requested=False) -> tuple[str, ...]`. The retention classes are `retained_user_tree` and `rebuildable_cache`. The only action strings are `begin_capture`, `save_recovery_point`, `inspect_api_health`, `inspect_deployed_revision`, `inspect_backlog_pressure`, `replace_retained_tree`, `rebuild_cache`, and `confirm_result`. A missing destination begins capture. An existing rebuildable cache is rebuilt directly. An existing retained tree is replaced after any requested recovery point and the current approved incident checks. Apply the current approved Tide Ledger behavior supplied with this task, reject unknown retention classes with `ValueError`, change only `src/transfer_policy.py`, and run `python3 -m unittest discover -v`.
